content.help: Turn off to restore original cubemaps and stop reflection processing and diagnostics. Other options are hidden while disabled. Runtime changes apply when gameplay resumes.
Sharpest: mip 0 (128x128). Sharper: mip 1 (64x64). Neutral: mip 2 (32x32, default). Softer: mip 3 (16x16). Softest: mip 4 (8x8). Applies when gameplay resumes.

Adjust captured reflections as you move. Enabling this adds GPU work and may reduce FPS while moving. Disable it to reduce the performance cost. Changing this restarts movement history. Enabled by default.
Enable detailed logs, sampled performance timings and cache statistics for troubleshooting. Off by default. Disable for normal gameplay. Changes apply when gameplay resumes.
